fields.description: What the user sees on the Correspondence Request form. Can be edited freely at any time - unlike fieldname_slug below, changing this never affects any already-stored data.
fields.label: Label

fields.description: Built once from the first Label entered (slugified + a short random suffix to avoid collisions), then locked. This is the real, permanent column name behind this field (as csf_ followed by this value on Correspondence Request and Correspondence) - it never changes again even if Label is edited later, so previously-entered data is never orphaned.
fields.label: Field Name (auto, permanent)

fields.description: For Select: one option per line. For Link: the target DocType's exact name.
fields.label: Options

fields.description: erpnext: this field is skipped entirely (with a logged warning) on a site that doesn't have ERPNext installed, instead of failing the sync.
fields.label: Link Scope

fields.description: Unchecking this hides the field everywhere immediately (Desk form, portal) without deleting its column or any value already stored in it. Use the doctype's own delete-row action only for a field that was never actually used.
fields.label: Active

fields.description: Reuse: this row shares its real column with another category's field of the same name - e.g. both "Invoices" and "Checks" showing an "Amount" field that's really the same underlying data. Never matched automatically by Label alone (two unrelated fields can share a label by coincidence) - must be chosen explicitly here.
fields.label: Definition

fields.description: Enter the exact "Field Name (auto, permanent)" value of the field to reuse, from any other category. Field Type/Options/Link Scope are then taken from that existing definition, not from what's set above, to guarantee the shared column stays consistent everywhere it's used.
fields.label: Existing Field Name To Reuse
